fact: The national digital health strategy states that USAID and Chemonics supported the Ministry for interoperability of DHIS2 with other subsystems (e-SIGL, iHRIS, eLMIS), and that only the Sino-Guinean hospital has a partial digitised patient system, in isolation.
title: Stratégie nationale de santé numérique 2021-2025
publisher: Ministère de la Santé, République de Guinée
